label: Intellectual life is more perfect through self-direction to ends
summary: The article grades life through self-operation: plants as to execution, animals also as to the form acquired through sense, and intellectual beings as to ordering to an end. In humans this is compatible with first principles and the ultimate end being fixed by nature. The highest case is argued separately, where nature is its very act of understanding.
blocker: The source takes intellectual self-direction itself as a way of living, against confining life to bodily functions. The route needs every HasIntellect bearer to have or exercise self-operation in the precise timeless Operates reading of LIVING_1. The source passage’s gradation does not resolve how an entirely unexercised capacity would satisfy that predicate.
